next_action: Create a case registry linking each figure to complete inputs and source/version evidence.

requirement: Implement native reading, selection and case input generation
scope: All six inspected experimental families; inherited Dataset behavior, explicit overrides and transient schedule semantics
gap: Native Bartolomey loading, one-based record selection, explicit overrides and steady input generation are implemented and tested across all 34 XML records. Raw repeated/empty values, source hashes and case identities are retained; the pilot executed four selected records. The other five dataset families, inherited general Dataset API and transient partial-record inheritance remain unimplemented. Source-implementation inspection and native fixtures are not an executed MATLAB generated-input comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Retain raw XML values, missing entries, repeated fields, record identifiers, source hashes and citations.
Match geometry, pressure, inlet enthalpy, mass flow, power, axial heating and default/override precedence.
Verify mass flux times area equals mass flow and integrated prescribed heating equals power within documented input precision.
For transient partial records, match initial-state inheritance rather than silently inheriting a previous transient record.
next_action: Extend the checked adapter contract to the remaining families and transient inheritance; obtain independent MATLAB effective-input exports before claiming cross-runtime input-generation equivalence.

requirement: Match the actual measured quantity and coordinate system
scope: Film/base/wave quantities, void fraction, quality, heat transfer and dryout measurements
gap: Bartolomey equilibrium-quality [1] and inlet-elevation [m] observations now retain their source definitions and match predictions by strict within-domain linear interpolation. Missing and out-of-domain values have explicit exclusions; negative digitized void values remain flagged, not clipped. The 59 selected measurements were all compared for both frozen models (118 finest-grid pairs; zero exclusions). Film/wave, thermal and dryout definitions and uncertainty propagation remain outside this implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Carry SI dimensions while preserving raw units; explicitly distinguish wave number density (m^-1), frequency (Hz), period (s), and velocity (m/s).
Use period=1/f and frequency=U_wave*N only with verified source definitions; track derived quantities and correlated uncertainties.
Record axial origin and use within-domain interpolation with stated numerical error; no silent clamping or extrapolation.
Missing measurements remain missing and relative errors are not computed with physically meaningless near-zero denominators.
next_action: Extend observation contracts to the remaining datasets, recover coordinate/digitization uncertainty, and retain direct versus derived observables separately.

scope: Measurement, digitization/transcription, input and numerical uncertainty for each compared quantity
gap: NUREG/IA-0025 section 3.1, printed p.9 reports an absolute void-fraction error below 0.04 for its tests, without a stated confidence level or distribution; example input-error bounds apply to its 1982 reference. The pilot freezes descriptive-only comparisons and numerical sensitivity screens before predictions. Digitization/coordinate uncertainty, group-specific input propagation, correlations and a combined uncertainty budget remain unresolved. The 0.04 bound is not a total experimental acceptance tolerance; three mesh screens failed and no asymptotic numerical uncertainty was estimated.
acceptance_criteria: Recover original experimental uncertainty and distinguish it from digitization/transcription and numerical uncertainty.
Document uncertainty propagation and correlations; label unavailable uncertainty as unknown.
Allow descriptive comparisons with unknown uncertainty but prohibit an uncertainty-based pass claim.
Predeclare criteria before fitting; do not adopt plotting guides or baseline 1e-8 tolerances as experimental accuracy thresholds.
next_action: Recover case-group-specific uncertainty and digitization evidence, propagate applicable input/property uncertainty, and resolve failed mesh screens before defining any uncertainty-qualified validation acceptance.

requirement: Produce reproducible per-case and aggregate validation evidence
scope: All attempted cases, including nonconvergence, physical inconsistency and excluded measurements
gap: The Bartolomey campaign now accounts for all 40 attempted case/model/numerical variants, with inputs, hashes, units, convergence, explicit source-equation physical checks, paired errors, per-run CSVs and grouped descriptive statistics. All 40 executed and passed the stated physical gates; sensitivity failures remain visible (29/32 screens passed). Broader dataset reporting, statistical uncertainty and uncertainty-qualified experimental acceptance remain incomplete; the reported 118 finest-grid pairs reuse 59 source measurements across two models.
acceptance_criteria: Publish paired measured/calculated tables with dimensional signed errors, bias, MAE and RMSE for defined populations.
Report every attempted case and exclusion reason; do not hide nonconverged or physically inconsistent cases in aggregate scores.
Archive inputs, code/property/data versions, settings, sensitivity and comparison scripts.
Limit conclusions to measured quantities and tested fluid/geometry/regime/model configurations.
next_action: Retain the complete Bartolomey accounting as other datasets are added; investigate and report failed sensitivity screens without filtering cases or treating repeated predictions as independent measurements.

requirement: Execute the first measured-versus-calculated mixture cases
scope: Frozen XML entries 1,22,29,31: four subcooled-boiling groups, Quality and Elevation observations; HEM and source TUTORIAL2D Saha-Zuber/Bestion configurations; 100/200/400 cells with tighter-iteration and pseudo-time-step checks at 200 cells.
gap: Pilot infrastructure and descriptive comparisons executed: 40/40 runs converged and passed the predeclared steady mass/enthalpy, source discrete momentum, bounds, phase-area and boundary/heating gates. All 59 source measurements were compared under each model. Native numerical acceptance remains incomplete: entry 22 HEM changes by 0.0034520131 (100-to-200 cells) and 0.0043236369 (200-to-400); entry 29 Saha-Zuber/Bestion changes by 0.0050731955 (200-to-400), exceeding the unchanged 0.002 void-fraction mesh screen. All 16 tighter-iteration/pseudo-step screens passed. Experimental results are descriptive only; complete uncertainty, historical calibration independence, asymptotic convergence and independent MATLAB references are unestablished. This pilot is not a reproduction of the supplied 2025 papers. Saved-array diagnosis attributes row22 HEM failures to quality-zero interpolation brackets and row29 Saha-Zuber/Bestion failure mainly to mesh-dependent heated extent/power normalization; original failed criteria remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Select traceable representative records with matched geometry, heating, inlet state and measured void definition.
Freeze the selected mixture thermal/void closures before evaluation.
Demonstrate converged iterative/mesh settings and applicable balances; publish all paired measurements and errors.
State whether uncertainty permits acceptance or only descriptive comparison.
next_action: Diagnose the three failed mesh screens, particularly saturation/heating-transition resolution, using separately identified follow-on cases. Retain this frozen campaign and thresholds. Establish numerical uncertainty and the remaining experimental/input uncertainty before advancing validation claims.
